p0: TCB code integrity: the lease pins launcher_executable_sha256 but NOT executor_executable_sha256, and no contract requires TCB binaries to be root-owned / non-writable by the in-scope login user -> a sidecar can swap the executor/launcher binary and obtain a genuinely-signed forged trusted_verified.
Distinct-UID linchpin never specified for the desktop's own sidecar (a child inherits the backend UID); on a single-UID desktop the whole ACL/principal-separation model collapses.
Windows (the primary platform) has ZERO normative design; 'fail-closed on Windows' is unenforced prose, not a specified+tested runtime gate.
